atAGlance: Sữa tươi is fresh milk on Vietnamese menus, often sweetened unless you ask for không đường.
whatItIs: Sữa tươi is milk served bottled, boxed, or café-style. Expect fresh milk, mild, creamy, and usually sweetened unless specified.
howToEnjoy: Ask whether it is có đường or không đường if sweetness matters.
howLocalsOrder: Sữa tươi may be boxed, bottled, or café-poured. Ask không đường if you want unsweetened milk, because sweetened milk is common in Vietnam.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Sữa tươi is useful on Vietnamese menus because milk often comes in sweetened and unsweetened versions.
